title: A simple AI service for local businesses
topic: Setting up AI chat replies for local businesses that miss enquiries
target_audience: Beginners who want a first AI service to sell
audience_problem: They want to sell AI services but don't know what local businesses would pay for

beats.voiceover: Your local hairdresser can't answer messages mid-haircut.
beats.visual: Stock clip: hairdresser cutting hair, phone buzzing on the side.

beats.voiceover: So enquiries sit there unanswered, and some of those people just book somewhere else.
beats.visual: Mock message thread with 'Seen' and no reply; clock jumps forward.

beats.voiceover: That's a simple AI service you could learn to offer: an assistant that answers common questions and sends the booking link.
beats.on_screen_text: AI that answers + sends the booking link
beats.visual: Screen mock-up of a chat assistant answering a price question (fictional business).

beats.voiceover: Keep it narrow. One type of business, one job: replying to enquiries.
beats.visual: Talking head, holds up one finger.

beats.voiceover: For a dog groomer, that's answering 'how much for a small dog?' at nine at night, with wording the owner approved.
beats.visual: Phone mock-up at night, message answered instantly; small 'owner-approved' badge.

beats.voiceover: Follow and I'll show how to set one up, step by step.

instagram.cover_text: A simple AI service to sell
instagram.caption:
A simple AI service idea for beginners: help local businesses reply to enquiries when they're busy.

Keep it narrow:
- one type of business
- one job: answering common questions and sending the booking link
- the owner approves every answer

It takes effort to learn and to find clients - but it's a real problem you can see on any high street.

Follow and I'll show the setup step by step.

youtube.title: A Simple AI Service You Could Offer Local Businesses
youtube.description: Local businesses miss enquiries while they're busy. A narrow AI service: answer common questions and send the booking link, using wording the owner approves. Handle customer data carefully (UK GDPR).
youtube.pinned_comment: Which local business would you pick first?
